O Codex é o agente de código da OpenAI,: Codex is OpenAI's coding agent, and Gemini is Google's (through Antigravity CLI). Each uses its own login and plan, and must be installed on this computer.
O Gemini roda pelo Antigravity CLI (agy): Gemini runs through Google's Antigravity CLI (agy). Vitral opens the agy it finds in PATH or in ~/.local/bin. Update runs `agy update` outside any turn and shows what it answers; the new version applies from the next turn. No new-version check: agy doesn't publish one Vitral can read without installing.
O Vitral abre um processo do claude por: Vitral starts one claude process per turn; the version is that of the claude it finds (the one in PATH or in ~/.local/bin). Update runs `claude update` outside any turn and shows what it answers; the new version applies from the next turn, with no Vitral restart.

O Vitral conversa com ele pelo ACP (Agen: Vitral talks to it through ACP (Agent Client Protocol): the model and effort come from its own session, and permission requests show up in the chat. Plan usage isn't shown yet.
O Vitral pergunta ao npm qual é a versão: Vitral asks npm for the latest Claude Code and Codex versions and says “X is available” on the version lines. “Button only” checks nothing on open: the check runs when you click Check now.
O Vitral procura no GitHub a cada 6 h, c: Vitral checks GitHub every 6 h, verifies the signature before installing and never restarts on its own: the new version applies when you restart.

With nothing to say, it leaves a discreet line; with a finding, a card you can send to the chat's agent. When off, review stays available in “Review with…” on the “Worked…” line. Uses the other agent's plan on every reviewed turn.
O texto entra no fim do prompt de sistem: The text goes at the end of every chat's system prompt, for Claude and Codex, after what Vitral already sends (the chat folder and its rules). Applies from the next message.

Quando um chat manda mensagem a outro, o: When a chat messages another, or opens one, the target shows up in a tab of the active pane. The tab opens in the background: it doesn't change what you're reading or bring the window forward, and its outline shows it's running. If the chat is already in view or already a tab, nothing changes.
